method: Live Google Maps review tab, current Next Jump homepage and installation page, and public Birdeye listing. Selected excerpts; not a live feed.

dillon.quote: Great communication, great pricing, and amazing quality.
dillon.context: Dillon brought in a classic F-250 for a lift after struggling to find a shop willing to take on the job. His review highlights the team’s communication and care.

will.name: Will Coburn
will.quote: Extremely impressed with Next Jump’s staff

will.label: Google review

scope: No fabricated ratings or headshots. Kelly is explicitly a collaboration partner. Background truck photo appears only with the Super Ute collaboration it depicts. No matched review is currently supplied for work, marine outfitting or boat detailing.
